entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I have one of your VeloBands, the cadence sensor? I... I just don't think it's working right. I'm a bit overwhelmed with it.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble, but I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, it's definitely a fault. It's just not working. I've charged it and everything, but it won't sync with the app on my phone. I feel like it must be broken.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. It's frustrating when a new device doesn't connect properly. Do you think the unit is defective?
Yes, I think it's defective. I don't know what else it could be. I'm just so confused by all this. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. Let me just pull up your account. I see here that your order was delivered 17 days ago. Let me check our policy for you.
Okay... I hope that's not too long. I was really trying to get it to work.
Not at all. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. Since it seems you received a broken item, I can go ahead and process a return for a full refund right away.
Oh! Really? That's it? I can just send it back? I was so worried I was stuck with it.

Absolutely. I've just initiated that for you. I'm sending an email right now with a prepaid shipping label. Just package the VeloBand back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. That was much easier than I thought it would be.
You're very welcome. We want to make sure you have a good experience with VeloFit. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Have a wonderful day.
